content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lancaster

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders face different thresholds. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify your qualifications and identify any gaps.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Lancaster-area cohorts meet on a schedule designed for working professionals. You'll earn the 35 required contact hours through interactive sessions, real-world case studies, and direct access to certified instructors throughout the program.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your formal education, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the application process, ensure your documentation is complete, and answer questions about eligibility verification. PMI typically reviews applications within two weeks.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to build confidence before test day. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts and address weak areas. Schedule your PMP exam at a PMI-approved testing center and arrive ready to demonstrate your project-management expertise.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by attending training, contributing to the profession, or giving back to your community. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning opportunities to help you accumulate PDUs and stay current with evolving best practices.
